title: senna cana
intro: Senna cana, commonly known as the Combretum or Combretum senna, is a plant species in the Combretaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as aiding digestion and relieving constipation due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna cana include stimulating the bowel movement and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
